content.title: Chapter 102 - UTILITIES — Sec. 102-104. - Special equipment for hoses used to wash vehicles.
content.summary:
Hoses used for washing of vehicles shall be equipped with a shut-off valve that is
               normally closed and necessitates hand pressure on the valve to permit the flow of
               water.
(Code 1981, § 33-54; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988)
